reviews.title: Pay
reviews.text: Why would anyone pay for this?

reviews.title: Moon image now gone
reviews.text:
Many (many!) years ago I chose this app because it had the coolest rendering of the moon. 
At a glance I could see what phase it was in and how close it was to being full-that’s all I really wanted. Over the years many features were added, then taken away-unless you subscribed. The latest update disappeared the moon image completely. 
Yes, I initially got this app for free, and never felt the need for an upgrade; but now it no longer serves a purpose for me. 
Sadly, I’m deleting this and will now find different moon app.
